0.label: MTC
0.title: Mitochondrial / OXPHOS
0.summary: Oxidative-phosphorylation–driven tumour. Matches the published MITOCHONDRIAL (MTC) subtype.
0.therapeutic: The MTC subtype carries the most favourable prognosis of the pathway-based subtypes and is selectively vulnerable to OXPHOS inhibitors (Garofano et al., Nature Cancer 2021).

1.label: PN
1.title: Proneural / Progenitor
1.summary: Neural-progenitor programme with high proliferation. 96% of this group match the Verhaak Proneural signature.
1.therapeutic: No subtype-specific approved therapy; proliferative programme is the dominant feature.

2.label: CL
2.title: Classical / EGFR
2.summary: EGFR / RTK-MAPK axis. EGFR together with its own negative-feedback regulators SPRY1/2/4 and SPRED2.
2.therapeutic: EGFR is the canonical Classical-subtype axis; EGFR-directed strategies are the established research direction.

3.label: MES
3.title: Mesenchymal / Immune
3.summary: Heavy myeloid and microglia-macrophage infiltration with complement activation. The purest subtype found (98% Verhaak-Mesenchymal).
3.therapeutic: Dense immune infiltration makes this the most immunotherapy-relevant group in the cohort.

4.label: INT
4.title: Intermediate / Mixed
4.summary: No dominant signature. Best interpreted as tumours sitting between states rather than a separate entity.
4.therapeutic: Reported honestly as transitional — no subtype-specific claim is made.

5.label: OLIGO
5.title: Oligodendrocytic / Myelin
5.summary: Myelin-high with a strong neuronal component — partly OPC-like tumour biology, partly white-matter admixture.
5.therapeutic: Corresponds to the neural/oligodendrocyte axis; the historic "Neural" subtype was retired for this reason.
